title: EIGHTH AMENDMENT TO AMENDED AND RESTATED AGREEMENT NO. 17-3425-A BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES HARBOR DEPARTMENT AND WABTEC TRANSPORTATION SYSTEMS, LLC
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - EIGHTH AMENDMENT TO AMENDED AND RESTATED AGREEMENT NO. 17-3425-A BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES HARBOR DEPARTMENT AND WABTEC TRANSPORTATION SYSTEMS, LLC
Transmittal 1
Summary
: Staff requests approval of the Eighth Amendment (Amendment) to Amended and Restated Agreement No. 17-3425-A (Agreement) with Wabtec Transportation Systems, LLC (Wabtec) for the continued operation, maintenance, support, and enhancement of the Port Optimizer platform. This Amendment is in alignment with Strategic Plan Objective 2: An Efficient, Secure, and Sustainable Supply Chain. The Port Optimizer is a common user portal that provides a single information window supporting enhanced maritime supply chain visibility, cargo movement, and operational efficiency throughout the Port of Los Angeles (Port). Since its initial deployment, the platform has expanded to support a growing number of operational capabilities, data integrations, and technology services that benefit the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department (Harbor Department) and the Port community. The proposed Eighth Amendment extends the term of the agreement by three additional years to November 3, 2029, for a total term of thirteen years, increases the not-to-exceed compensation by $14,781,600 for a total of $56,332,020, establishes an updated Statement of Work (Transmittal 1, Exhibit A-1 and Exhibit A-2), adds Supplemental Terms and Conditions (Transmittal 1, Exhibit H-1), and Intellectual Property Rights (Transmittal 1, Exhibit L). Expenditures incurred under the Agreement will remain the financial responsibility of the Harbor Department.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively and categorically exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II Section 2(f) and Article III Class 6(2) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) find that, in accordance with Los Angeles City Charter Section 1022, it is more feasible for outside contractors to perform the specialized software development, hosting, maintenance, technical support, and operational services than City employees; 3) approve the proposed Eighth Amendment to Amended and Restated Agreement No. 17-3425-A to continue the operation, maintenance, support, and enhancement of the Port Optimizer platform; 4) direct the Board Secretary to transmit said Amendment to the Los Angeles City Council for approval pursuant to Section 373 of the Charter of the City of Los Angeles and Section 10.5 of the Los Angeles Administrative Code; 5) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to the Amendment for and on behalf of the Board upon approval by City Council; and 6) adopt Resolution No. __________.
Port Pilots
summary: Approval of Eighth Amendment to agreement with Wabtec Transportation Systems, LLC for continued operation and enhancement of Port Optimizer platform through 2029.
